subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` block supervised/headless Gateway `update.run` managed-service handoffs, or remain scoped to configured background auto-update applies only?
rationale: The code path is clear, but changing the env var scope affects explicit operator/admin update requests and documented updater behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Extend kill-switch to managed update.run
options.body: Gate supervised `update.run` handoffs before creating the handoff or scheduling restart, and document the env var as an operator hold for headless managed updates.

options.title: Document current split
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` scoped to configured automatic applies and make docs state that explicit `update.run` remains allowed.

options.title: Add a separate explicit hold
options.body: Introduce a distinct opt-in operator hold for control-plane update restarts, avoiding a meaning change for the existing auto-update env var.

recommendation.title: Extend kill-switch to managed update.run
recommendation.body: Gate supervised `update.run` handoffs before creating the handoff or scheduling restart, and document the env var as an operator hold for headless managed updates.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current kill-switch and are closest to the updater safety contract this issue asks to broaden.
